Crazy Cool Cocktails!
Feb 2020
The Tipsy Cow is a fabulous little cocktail bar tucked down a quiet side street, but well worth hunting out. We enjoyed it so much we went there twice in one night, and can highly recommend cocktails such as The Defroster (nice and hot and spicy!), The Pretty Women, and The Purple Nipple (maybe the first cocktail I’ve ever come across with beet juice). The staff are a delight; the cocktail maestro herself is a joy to watch as she oh-so-carefully crafts these works of inspirational liquid genius. The manager/owner, Mr. Bin is a true gentleman, who goes out of his way to make his guests feel welcome, and the cocktail waitress can’t stop herself moving to the rhythm of one of the best playlists we’ve ever come across in any bar anywhere (--and, sorry to say, that’s a respectably large sample size). So, do yourself a favor –if in Saigon for a night, pop on over to the Tipsy Cow and grab an experience you won’t soon forget!
